LESSON: LANGUAGE STRUCTURES SCHOOL

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Language structures School

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Language structures School. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What is Sarah holding?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate the importance of subject- verb agreement in conversation for effective communication.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. appreciate the importance of subject- verb agreement in conversation for effective communication.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the importance of subject- verb agreement in conversation for effective communication. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Language structures School.
2. Explain Language structures School to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: Learners construct correct 1)
4. Show that you can: appreciate the importance of subject- verb agreement in conversation for effective communication.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Language structures School. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: What is Sarah holding?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Learners construct correct 1)

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. appreciate the importance of subject- verb agreement in conversation for effective communication.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
